scene: Freddie Mercury and Queen's record label originally refused to release 'Bohemian Rhapsody' as a single because at nearly 6 minutes it was 'too long to ever be played on the radio'.
explain: REAL! EMI executives told Queen the 5-minute 55-second opera-rock track would never be a hit. Queen leaked it to DJ Kenny Everett, who played it 14 times in two days due to listener demand!
